Generated Narrative: CodeSystem TrustDemoCodeMappingBasis

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/trust-demo/CodeSystem/TrustDemoCodeMappingBasis defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
concept-map By the national ConceptMapThe issuer's product code has an equivalent schedule code in the national map.
clinician-confirmed Confirmed by the clinicianThe map had no entry; the clinician confirmed the equivalent, and the decision is added to the map.
unmapped UnmappedNo equivalent is known; the issuer's code is kept as it is and shown as unmapped.
not-imported Not importedThe dose was not verified, so it was not imported and not mapped.
